exposure: Presence or absence of chorioamnionitis or endometritis
outcome: Change in white blood cell (WBC) count from admission to postpartum day one
cohort: This study included 2,245 patients who delivered a live fetus at 37 weeks or later.
finding: The average rise in WBC count after delivery was 2.99 × 103/mm3, with the 95th percentile at 20.19 × 103/mm3.
mod_finding: The average rise in WBC count was significantly higher after vaginal delivery (3.31 × 103/mm3) compared to cesarean section (2.34 × 103/mm3) (p < 0.001).
